note: Alberta Parks campground at the Elkwater townsite, by the campground registration booth; the year-round Lakeview shower house (showers, flush toilets, drinking water) is at its entrance and a playground is nearby. Lakeview Drive and a willow marsh lie between the loop and Elkwater Lake. Accessible site: Lakeview #1. --Claude
